name: cfc-backend
description: CFC platform API — Node + Express + MongoDB Atlas. Serves the consumer, pro and admin apps in ../cfc-frontend.
_comment_type: No "type": "module" on purpose. @cfc/types declares no module type, so tsx compiles it as CJS; declaring this project ESM puts a dual-module boundary between them and `export * from` chains stop static-linking across it (ApiError resolves as undefined). Matching it means runtime values from @cfc/types import normally, which BACKEND-PLAN.md §9 depends on — permission.ts, the GST constants and the earnings engine are ported, not re-derived.
